description: String section preset. Airy bed under the vocal; tube as saturator with ~zero reduction. Generous hall send via send.set (slot 0).
name: strings-pad
notes: Precondition: Strings track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/strings-pad.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Low-cut / low-mid ease are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Hall reverb is manual (no send API); see reference file.
